name: Cloth Confidence
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, occultist 1, spiritualist 1, psychic 1, shaman 1; Focus sybarite 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close
Target one creature, plus one additional creature/3 levels
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, each target chooses a skill associated with the outfit they wear. While a target wears their respective outfit, they gain a +1 morale bonus to checks made with the chosen skill. If the outfit is part of a disguise, they gain the same bonus to relevant Disguise checks. The bonus increases by +1 at 3rd level, and every four levels thereafter. They may take 10 on any check that benefits from the bonus, even while threatened.

Cloth Confidence, Forced

School illusion (phantasm)) [emotion, mind-affecting, ruse]; Level bard 3, medium 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, spiritualist 3, psychic 3, shaman 3; Focus sybarite 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close
Target one creature, plus one additional creature/3 levels
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

As cloth confidence, except you may choose the skill associated with a target’s outfit in its place, and the targets will employ the chosen skill at the expense of other tasks. For the duration, each target’s primary goal becomes taking tasks under the purview of its chosen skill. It retains only vague awareness of its other objectives and only pursues them of their own accord if they know a way to do so in tandem with their primary goal. Otherwise, it will unconsciously avoid any other task to the best of its ability. to identify forced cloth confidence with a skill check incorrectly identify it as cloth confidence.
